summary: Full non-regression + new Kiltikonet institutional rebrand testing. All 17 review criteria PASS. Backend: /api/health minimal, /api/admin/health-detailed 403, robots.txt has the 3 new Disallow (/participant/, /mon-espace/, /espace-pro/), sitemap.xml points to kiltikonet.fr with 0 participant UUIDs and includes /culture-connect/2026, /culture-connect/2027, /infrastructure, /rejoindre, /contact. Gouvernance stats + badges/types 200. Badge inscription POST returned CC26-VIS-PO705. Frontend: / renders new KiltikonetHome (data-testid=kiltikonet-home, correct H1 'Un réseau. Une infrastructure. Une culture qui se relie.', eyebrow 'UNE INITIATIVE CVLN GROUP' present, 4 pillars found, doc title 'Kiltikonet — Réseau et infrastructure culturelle afro-caribéenne'). /culture-connect, /culture-connect/2026, /culture-connect/2027, /infrastructure, /rejoindre, /contact all render with their expected data-testid and H1. /legacy-cc2026 loads without error. Header nav shows all 7 Kiltikonet-first items. hCaptcha widget still renders on /badge-inscription with 2 hcaptcha iframes.

issues: IntroSequence overlay intercepts nav clicks on first visit. Storage key is 'kk_visited' (not 'kk_intro_seen' as documented in agent-to-agent context). Use ?skip_intro=1 or set localStorage.kk_visited='true' for automated tests.

action_items: Optional: update agent-to-agent context to reflect actual intro-skip key ('kk_visited') and available '?skip_intro=1' URL param.

Optional: consider adding Content-Security-Policy header (with https://*.hcaptcha.com) on frontend HTML responses. Currently NO CSP header is emitted for / or /badge-inscription — hCaptcha still functions (iframes load), but the review criterion 'Header CSP doit toujours contenir hcaptcha.com' is not literally satisfied. Since functionality is intact, marked as informational only.
critical_code_review_comments: Header nav items appear as spans, not <a href>, based on Playwright selector results (locator(header a[href='/culture-connect']) returned 0 while header >> text=Culture Connect returned 1). If accurate, this hurts SEO/accessibility — links should be real <a> or React <Link>.
Multiple Three.js instances warning ('Multiple instances of Three.js being imported') — should be deduped in bundling.
Invalid DOM property fetchpriority (React expects fetchPriority camelCase) — 1 console error observed on legacy page.
test_credentials: Not used in this iteration (public routes only).
seed_data_creation: One badge created via POST /api/badges/inscrire (email test_review_<ts>@example.com) — not cleaned up.
